prompt: Create a third distinct desktop web-app composition for ResQCloud, preserving the same warm ivory, deep teal, restrained brick, humanist sans, fine rules and compact controls. 1440x1000. Reference contributes palette, typography and chrome only. Map-first layout: role-scoped persistent navigation, slim top bar, heading and priority action summary, then a large 60% map panel beside a 40% focused priority queue with severity, status and next action. Use pale abstract streets with four labeled sample incident pins and a visible text legend. Label sample data. No external emergency claims, fake real geography, gradients, glass or military motifs.
